description: Real-reference fixture for sub0::qwen_tok, this engine's reimplementation of the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next byte-level BPE tokenizer. Every expected value was produced by the real tokenizer, not hand-derived.

source.cross_check: transformers.models.qwen3_5.Qwen3_5Tokenizer (transformers' own model_type map sends qwen4_exp here); every case agreed
source.NOT_the_oracle: transformers.AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(...), which honours the stale tokenizer_class='Qwen2Tokenizer' field and rebuilds the pipeline with an OLDER pre-tokenization regex that lacks \p{M} -- see docs/QWEN_TOKENIZER.md sec 2.1

files.encode_cases.tsv: label / hex(input) / token ids / hex(reference decode(ids))
files.pretokenize_cases.tsv: label / hex(NFC(input)) / hex of each pre-token chunk
files.decode_cases.tsv: label / token ids / hex(reference decode(ids)) -- id sequences encode() never produces: truncated multi-byte characters and the model's padding rows

decode_convention: skip_special_tokens=False (transformers' own default). `tokenizers`' raw Tokenizer.decode defaults to True and would drop the 20 tokens flagged `special`; that is a display policy, not a decode, and it breaks the decode(encode(x)) == NFC(x) round trip.
